mapper.insert: insert into mcp_token (user_id, name, token_prefix, token_suffix, token_hash, status) values (#{userId}, #{name}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{tokenSuffix}, #{tokenHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, token_prefix, token_suffix, token_hash, status, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at from mcp_token where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active' order by id desc
select id, user_id, name, token_prefix, token_suffix, token_hash, status, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at from mcp_token where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, name, token_prefix, token_suffix, token_hash, status, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at from mcp_token where token_hash = #{tokenHash} and status = 'active' limit 1
mapper.update: update mcp_token set last_used_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = 'active'
